summary: Frontend-only regression test after NotesApp.jsx refactor (1338 lines split into /app/frontend/src/notes/*). Exercised all 14 review scenarios end-to-end on the live preview URL. Every flow works and there are ZERO console errors / page errors. The Icon view + IconPicker (8 categories) + BackgroundPicker (color/gradient/image tabs, 10 gradients) integrate cleanly with NoteModal, create/edit/fullscreen/delete flows, and view_mode persists in IndexedDB across reload.
passed_tests: App loads at `/` and shows Iron Rabbit header, search bar, view-toggle, group-toggle, and FAB ([data-testid=app-container], view-mode-toggle, view-mode-list, view-mode-icon, group-toggle, fab-add-note all visible).
Header title = 'Iron Rabbit'; company website link (ironrabbitapps.com) rendered.
View toggle: clicking [data-testid=view-mode-icon] switches to grid; clicking [data-testid=view-mode-list] switches back to accordion (verified 1 accordion item after switch back).

view_mode PERSISTENCE: after full page reload, [data-testid=view-mode-icon] retains class 'active' — confirms StorageService.saveSettings({view_mode:'icon'}) writes to IndexedDB and fetchData rehydrates it (NotesApp.jsx L91).

Create-note flow: FAB → NoteModal opens (role=dialog). Filled title 'TEST_QA_Note'. Clicked [data-testid=editor-open-icon-picker] → [data-testid=icon-picker-dialog] opened → 8 category headings rendered → picked [data-testid=icon-option-ShoppingCart] → modal closed, button label became 'Icon: ShoppingCart'.

BackgroundPicker: clicked [data-testid=editor-open-bg-picker-btn] → [data-testid=background-picker-dialog] opened → switched to [data-testid=bg-tab-gradient] → 10 gradient options rendered → picked first → modal closed, button label became 'Background: Custom'.
Clicked 'Create' → modal closed, new tile 'TEST_QA_Note' rendered in icon-view grid with picked ShoppingCart icon and gradient background.
Edit flow: hover tile → [data-testid=note-tile-edit-<id>] appeared → clicked → NoteModal reopened with title='TEST_QA_Note' AND icon label='Icon: ShoppingCart' (pre-selected state preserved).

Fullscreen: clicking the tile body opened [data-testid=fullscreen-note]. Inline-edit title to 'TEST_QA_Note_edited' → save-status pill transitioned to 'Saved' within 1.1s (700ms debounce confirmed working).
Search: typing 'TEST_QA' into search filtered to just the matching tile.
Group-by-category toggle: aria-pressed flips true↔false; grouping headings toggle correctly.

Settings modal: header settings icon opens dialog containing 'Backup', 'Restore', 'Clear', 'Storage' text. ('Install' PWA button not shown because beforeinstallprompt didn't fire in the automation browser — expected behaviour per NotesApp.jsx L677 `canInstallPWA={!!deferredPrompt}`.)
Calculator: header calculator icon opens calculator dialog.
Delete: reopened tile in fullscreen → clicked [data-testid=fullscreen-delete-btn] → tile removed from grid (0 remaining).

ZERO console errors and ZERO pageerrors across the entire flow — previous Radix a11y warning about missing DialogDescription is resolved (both NoteModal, IconPicker, BackgroundPicker now include <DialogDescription>).
critical_code_review_comments: NotesApp.jsx is now a lean 693-line orchestrator (down from 1338) — well-scoped state, useMemo for processedNotes/grouped, imports are grouped logically. Good refactor outcome.

handleChangeViewMode (L232-240) correctly persists to IndexedDB via StorageService.saveSettings({view_mode: mode}); fetchData reads settings.view_mode on load (L91). Verified via reload persistence test.
NoteTile.jsx uses `LucideIcons[note.icon]` dynamic lookup with StickyNote fallback — safe for unknown icon names, and getBackgroundStyle handles null gracefully with a default gradient.
IconPicker: 8 categories filtered client-side by label/name search; each option has stable [data-testid=icon-option-<Name>]. Clean.
BackgroundPicker: image upload downscales via canvas to maxSide=800 with JPEG quality 0.85 — keeps IndexedDB payloads small (MAX_IMAGE_BYTES=800KB, hard cap ~5MB pre-downscale). Good.
All three new dialogs (NoteModal, IconPicker, BackgroundPicker) include <DialogDescription> — the Radix a11y warning noted in iterations 4-6 is now gone.

Minor code observation (non-blocking): NotesApp still imports BACKEND_URL and calls StorageService.migrateFromBackend(BACKEND_URL) on every fetchData (L77). This is guarded to only run once and skip if already migrated, so no ill effect — noted for awareness.

Minor UX: when there are 0 notes, toggling to icon view shows the 'No notes yet' empty state without the notes-grid container (renderNotes early-returns before viewMode branch, NotesApp.jsx L377) — this is correct/consistent behaviour.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 14 reviewed scenarios pass, 0 console errors

seed_data_creation: Created and then DELETED one test note 'TEST_QA_Note' (icon=ShoppingCart, gradient background) during the flow. No residual test data left in IndexedDB for the automation session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression is clean after the NotesApp.jsx refactor. Key data-testids for future tests: view-mode-list / view-mode-icon / group-toggle / fab-add-note / editor-open-icon-picker / editor-open-bg-picker-btn / icon-picker-dialog / icon-option-<Name> / background-picker-dialog / bg-tab-color|gradient|image / bg-gradient-<name> / bg-color-<name> / bg-image-upload / note-tile-<id> / note-tile-edit-<id> / fullscreen-note / fullscreen-title-input / fullscreen-content-input / fullscreen-save-status / fullscreen-close-btn / fullscreen-delete-btn. Auto-save debounce is 700ms — wait ~900-1200ms after keystroke before asserting 'Saved'. PWA install button will not appear in Playwright/headless because `beforeinstallprompt` isn't fired — that's expected, not a bug.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this regression.
